_comment: Captured from claude 2.1.226 in the dev container, by writing one line to a
child and reading the first line back:
Trimmed for the repo: `commands` kept three of ~50 entries (this parse ignores
it), and `account` / `pid` replaced with stand-ins — the real reply carries the
operator's email address. `request_id` echoes whatever we sent.

commands.name: model
commands.description: Set the AI model for Claude Code

commands.name: agents
commands.description: (removed) Ask Claude to create/manage subagents, or edit .claude/agents/

commands.name: usage
commands.description: Show session cost, plan usage, and what's contributing to your limits

agents.name: claude
agents.description: Catch-all for any task that doesn't fit a more specific agent. FleetView's default when no agent name is typed.

agents.name: Explore
agents.description: Fast read-only search agent for locating code. Use it to find files by pattern (eg. "src/components/**/*.tsx"), grep for symbols or keywords (eg. "API endpoints"), or answer "where is X defined / which files reference Y."

agents.name: general-purpose
agents.description: General-purpose agent for researching complex questions, searching for code, and executing multi-step tasks.

agents.name: Plan
agents.description: Software architect agent for designing implementation plans. Use this when you need to plan the implementation strategy for a task.

agents.name: statusline-setup
agents.description: Use this agent to configure the user's Claude Code status line setting.

models.description: Fable 5 · Most capable for your hardest and longest-running tasks · Requires usage credits
Opus 5 · Best for everyday, complex tasks · ~2× usage vs Sonnet
